An '''asteroid mine''' was used as the location of a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] operation. A group of [[Letaki]] were at the [[Mining/Legends|mine]], circa [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. The Letaki were approached by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Alia Terae]], whom they told about the slave trade that passed through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and the path through the [[Mining/Legends|mine's]] tunnels to reach the slave holding pens. Terae then led her companions, Han Solo and the Human [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sian Tesar]], per the Letaki's instructions.
